comments.author: Sylvia
comments.body:
Because they are both EA row ships with huge crew and DHP + PreEmp as optional skills.

MLA excel at:
100 more dura
5 more base armor
75 more crew
5 broadsides

MKW excel at:
2 more improves end up higher armour
2 more turn 2 more wave 1 more sail slot
can be used at much lower level

Clearly ALA is still superior but MKW is still great. Dura is the most important stat against crit, both ALA and MKW has mediocre dura but they are hard to be crit, so they are concerned with broadside hits, and for broadside hits armour is important, and MKW has very high armor for row boat. They both have gigantic crew with PreEmp so no issues there.

Well, it has 255 crew which is more than RHG/FLR/CLR.
It has Pre-Emptive Attack (+20% Atk +20% Def and strike first).
It has Direct Hit Prevention (immune to criticals from the front).
Which makes it similar to ALA, with less crew/dura but higher armour due to 8 improve slots.
Or you can use the Assault Deck Battle skill and force deck battle since 255 crew you can stay in melee until you succeed and Direct Hit Prevention + Row you can charge in pretty quickly.
